info.title: Webmania API1 B2B reseller issuer management
info.description: The three operations published in the B2B management guide. Separate credential scope and client from company API1 fiscal operations. No company setup/update route is invented here; updating issuer setup remains a separate company-authenticated fiscal API operation.

post.description: Requires an eligible authenticated reseller subscription and four reseller-scoped headers. Creates company slots and may affect billing and token provisioning. A batch can fail after earlier slots were created; there is no proven atomicity/idempotency guarantee. Do not automatically retry an uncertain result. Additional cliente/assinatura override fields are not part of the documented public request.

200.description: Successful business result. Additional response fields are preserved. A present error property is a functional failure even at HTTP 200.

default.description: Authentication, ownership, plan or business error, possibly HTTP 200. No automatic retry.

post.x-sensitive-response-policy: Return successful credential values to the authorized caller. Never log/debug/serialize them implicitly or echo them in errors. HTTP request bodies containing certificates/passwords are also sensitive.
post.x-rate-limit: Equivalent reseller calls are normally limited to one per second; SDK retries remain disabled.

get.summary: List reseller-owned companies and their credentials
get.description: Top-level array with nested credenciais. A missing cached company Bearer triggers a recovery request and token cache write. This GET is not a passive acceptance test on arbitrary company state. When the reseller has no companies the API returns a functional error object, not necessarily an empty array. No public pagination parameters are implemented.

get.summary: Count processed production notes by reseller company

parameters.name: mes
parameters.description: Defaults independently to the current server month.

parameters.name: ano
parameters.description: Only the current server year or its preceding year is accepted. Defaults independently to the current year; historical documentation examples do not override this rolling window.

get.description: Counts approved, cancelled and closed documents in production (ambiente=1) for the authenticated reseller companies and selected month/year. These are processed-note counts, not a count of all HTTP calls. Cache/lock writes can occur, but this operation does not issue or change fiscal documents. No pagination.

B2bError.description: A present error property is a functional failure, including HTTP 200. Preserve HTTP status and redact secrets from all failure diagnostics.

ResellerCreateCompaniesRequest.description: Create 1 through 100 company slots on the authenticated reseller subscription. Values greater than 100 are rejected even though the error message says less than 100. Public JSON input is an integer; legacy digit stripping is not a recommendation to send malformed strings.
